# Progress: 49/64, need 15 more purple pixels.
# Each green block adds 3, so need 5 more green blocks.
# Continue cycle: ACTION7, collect, repeat.

# Loop until level completes
max_rounds = 10
for round_num in range(max_rounds):
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    
    # Check progress
    p_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p']
    w_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
    p_pixels = p_nodes[0]['pixels'] if p_nodes else 0
    w_pixels = w_nodes[0]['pixels'] if w_nodes else 0
    print(f"Round {round_num}: Progress {p_pixels}/{p_pixels+w_pixels}")
    
    if p_pixels >= 64:
        print("Level should be complete!")
        break
    
    # ACTION7 to spawn green blocks
    result = action(['ACTION7'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    
    if not green_blocks:
        print("No green blocks spawned!")
        break
    
    # Get player position
    player_b = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
    p_min_c = min(x[1] for x in player_b[0]['boundary'])
    p_max_c = max(x[1] for x in player_b[0]['boundary'])
    p_center = (p_min_c + p_max_c) // 2
    
    # Collect all green blocks
    actions = []
    current_p_center = p_center
    for g in green_blocks:
        b = g['boundary']
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
        center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
        center_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2
        
        # Calculate moves to align player with green block
        diff = center_c - current_p_center
        if diff > 0:
            moves_needed = (diff + 4) // 5
            actions.extend(['RIGHT'] * moves_needed)
            current_p_center += moves_needed * 5
        elif diff < 0:
            moves_needed = ((-diff) + 4) // 5
            actions.extend(['LEFT'] * moves_needed)
            current_p_center -= moves_needed * 5
        
        # Click on green block
        actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})
    
    if actions:
        result = action(actions)
    
    # Check if level completed
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("Level completed!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
